name: Love In Corinthians
overview: The Scriptures emphasize that love is the fulfillment of God's commandments, commanding believers to love their neighbors as themselves, which is described as the greatest commandment (Mark 12:31). Genuine love is demonstrated through obedience to Christ's commands (John 14:15) and is exemplified supremely by the willingness to lay down one's life for others (John 15:13). Furthermore, love is presented as the debt believers owe to one another, fulfilling the law through mutual care and commitment (Romans 13:8).
